publication.title: BioCarian: Search engine for exploratory searches in heterogeneous biological databases

source_reading.scope: Implementation, query conversion/ranking, interface, results/case study, survey, conclusions and availability (§§Implementation–Availability).

adjudication.basis: BioCarian provides iterative free-text/SPARQL/faceted exploration of heterogeneous RDF biological databases with explicit human interaction and a 20-person survey. The report states that cross-database entity reconciliation is future work, so it must not be described as an already unified biological KG.

backend.source_model_description: {"data_model": "RDF/RDFS", "components": ["Jena TDB", "Apache Lucene via Jena text support", "SPARQL endpoint", "MVC", "Perl and PHP"], "remote": "Remote endpoint can be selected if it supplies required structural information; federated SPARQL editor example exists. Warehousing is the implemented main setup."}

studies.design: Worked HBV reanalysis plus usability/usefulness rating survey against Linked Life Data, Bio2RDF Virtuoso and GoPubmed.
limitations: No controlled task-time accuracy comparison or balanced cross-browser dataset protocol established in core report. Detailed survey supplement is not read.

descriptions.evaluation: Worked HBV reanalysis plus usability/usefulness rating survey against Linked Life Data, Bio2RDF Virtuoso and GoPubmed.

resources.notes: Current page identifies CoffeeCloud and explicitly disclaims representing/restoring the original BioCarian project; historical mentions do not establish the query service.
